data.title: Home
data.headline: Fine dining, private events, and fresh Italian American favorites.
data.intro: Savor is a BYOB restaurant in downtown Somerville known for intimate private rooms, warm hospitality, and a menu built around homemade pasta, polished entrees, and dependable event service.

children.text: Savor has happily served thousands of guests from Somerville and beyond with a style of service that feels polished without being stiff. Lunch, dinner, showers, rehearsal dinners, repasts, birthdays, and business gatherings all share the same attention to detail.

The dining room focuses on real food made fresh: house salads, classic starters, homemade pasta, seafood, steak, and event menus shaped around the occasion. Add BYOB flexibility and experienced event coordination, and Savor becomes an easy answer for both dinner reservations and milestone moments.

data.title: Private BYOB Event Venue & Catering
data.headline: A polished private event venue for showers, birthdays, repasts, and family gatherings.
data.intro: Our experienced team works closely with you to create the right room, menu, and pacing for the occasion.

children.text: We would love to host your next private event. Savor Restaurant is well prepared for joyful celebrations such as baby and bridal showers, as well as more reflective gatherings such as repasts and receptions.

Celebrate at Savor for baptisms, communions, confirmations, bar and bat mitzvahs, graduations, birthdays, engagements, rehearsals, promotions, anniversaries, or simply because your group wants a room that feels special.
Our goal is to make the day memorable for the right reasons: smooth planning, attentive service, and food guests will talk about afterward.

data.title: Corporate & Business Private Event Venue
data.headline: Host client dinners, team celebrations, and business meetings in a room that feels refined and easy.
data.intro: Savor combines contemporary dining rooms, flexible private spaces, and attentive service for professional events of many sizes.

children.text: Step into a world of tasteful design, ambient lighting, and hospitality that supports both intimate business dinners and larger team gatherings. The spaces feel elevated without losing warmth.
Whether you need a quiet room for a board dinner or want to celebrate a company milestone with a broader guest list, Savor offers flexible spaces and menus that make planning straightforward.
Our event team keeps the experience polished from inquiry through dessert so you can focus on the meeting, the clients, or the people you invited.

data.title: Bridal Showers and Rehearsal Dinners
data.headline: An elegant room for bridal showers, rehearsal dinners, and the people who matter most.
data.intro: Savor offers a fresh change of scenery, balancing comfort, hospitality, and polished dining for wedding weekend gatherings.

children.text: Bridal showers and rehearsal dinners deserve a room that feels celebratory from the moment guests arrive. Our private spaces offer a calm, elegant backdrop with menus built around your group.
Choose from rooms holding roughly 14 to 80 people, then work with us on timing, seating, and the pace of the meal. We keep it easy to host while still making the day feel meaningful.

data.title: Savor Restaurant Menu
data.headline: Real food, made fresh for lunch, dinner, dessert, and special occasions.
data.intro: Browse a representative selection of Savor favorites, from house salads and classic starters to homemade pasta, seafood, steak, and gelato.

children.text: Lunch is served until 3:00p and dinner reservations are recommended for busy evenings. Because Savor is BYOB, guests can pair their favorite bottles with handmade pasta, signature entrees, and desserts.

data.title: Delivery Menu
data.headline: Enjoy Savor at home with takeout and delivery from our Somerville kitchen.
data.intro: Order Italian American favorites for pickup or delivery, then use the parking map and app links if you are stopping by.

children.text: Savor Restaurant in Somerville offers takeout and delivery so you can enjoy house salads, pasta, seafood, and specials from home. Pickup and delivery availability may vary by time and location.
Need food for a larger group instead? Visit our takeout catering page for tray pricing and downloadable catering menus.

data.title: Take Out Catering
data.headline: Half trays, full trays, and crowd-ready catering for your next event.
data.intro: All options are priced by half and full trays, making it easy to feed office lunches, family celebrations, and at-home parties.

children.text: Takeout catering from Savor is designed for real hosting: trays that travel well, portions that make sense, and menus familiar enough to please a room full of guests.
Half trays typically serve 10 to 12 guests and full trays typically serve 20 to 25 guests. Download the lunch and dinner catering PDFs for expanded offerings and pricing.

data.title: Privacy Policy
data.headline: How Savor Restaurant handles website inquiries and reservations.
data.intro: This site exists to share restaurant information, event details, and contact options for Savor Restaurant.

children.text: When you contact Savor through email, reservations, or ordering links, the information you submit is used to respond to your inquiry, manage your reservation, or fulfill your order.

External services such as Resy, App2Food, social media platforms, and gift card providers operate under their own privacy practices. Please review those services directly if you share information through them.
Questions about this site or your data can be sent to Cater@savornjrestaurant.com.
